description: This file implements the Android-specific proxy configuration service for Chromium, handling proxy settings retrieval, override, and JNI interactions.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid
classes.description: Android-specific proxy configuration service that manages proxy settings, overrides, and JNI interactions.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid::Delegate
classes.description: Helper class managing JNI interactions, proxy config updates, and observer notifications.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid::ProxyOverrideRule
classes.description: Structure representing a proxy override rule with URL scheme and proxy URL.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with task runners and setting up JNI.

methods.name: set_exclude_pac_url
methods.description: Sets whether to exclude PAC URL from proxy configuration.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: ProxySettingsChangedTo
methods.description: Updates proxy settings to specific host, port, PAC URL, and exclusions.

methods.name: ProxySettingsChanged
methods.description: Notifies that proxy settings have changed.

methods.name: SetProxyOverride
methods.description: Sets proxy override rules and bypass list.
